District of Columbia v. Greater Washington Board of Trade

“The basic question that this case presents is whether Congress intended to prevent a State from computing workers compensation benefits…”; “Given the open-ended implications of todays holding… I think it is time to take a fresh look at the intended scope of the pre-emption provision that Congress enacted.”
